profile.title: Profile
profile.sessionNote: Sessions belong to one node: switching node asks you to sign in again.

password.title: Password
password.policy: At least 12 characters from three of: lowercase, uppercase, digits, symbols
password.mustChange: An administrator asks you to choose a new password.

errors.passwordClasses: Use three of: lowercase, uppercase, digits, symbols
errors.same: Choose a password different from the current one

totp.title: Two-factor authentication
totp.help: A 6-digit code from an authenticator app at each sign-in.
totp.step1: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, or type the secret.
totp.step2: Enter the 6-digit code it shows to confirm.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app

errors.code: Enter the 6 digits shown by the app

totp.mustEnroll: Your account needs two-factor authentication: set up an authenticator or a security key to continue.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.help: Saved to your account and applied on every node.
preferences.animationsHelp: Reduced keeps short fades and stops looping effects. Your system's reduced motion setting always applies.
preferences.ambientHelp: Ambient backgrounds are a faint graticule and live traces under the data. They stand still unless animations are full.

keys.title: Security keys and passkeys
keys.help: Sign in with a hardware key (YubiKey, Titan) or a passkey of your phone or computer, as a second factor or without a password. A key opens every node of the cluster.
keys.name: Key name
keys.removeHelp: Enter your password to remove this key. It can no longer sign in on any node.
keys.mustEnroll: Your role requires a security key: add one to continue.

unavailable.browser: This browser does not support security keys.
unavailable.ip_address: Security keys need the node's DNS name: open Pelagos by its name, not its IP address.
unavailable.outside_rp_id: Security keys of this cluster belong to {{rp}}: open the node by a name under that domain.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.help: For scripts and monitoring: send Authorization: Bearer <token>, no session cookie, no CSRF header, no security key prompt. Creating a token asks for your second factor again. A token never holds more than your own permissions and stops working when it expires or is revoked, on every node.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.cidrsHelp: Optional, comma or space separated, for example 192.0.2.0/24, 2001:db8::/64. Empty: any address.
tokens.codeHelp: Enter the code of your authenticator app to confirm.
tokens.createdHelp: Copy it now: it is shown only once and cannot be read back. Store it like a password.
tokens.revokeHelp: Scripts using it are refused on every node once the change has replicated (a few seconds).

errors.name: A name is required
errors.noFactor: Register a security key or enable TOTP first: creating a token needs a second factor.
errors.cancelled: The security key prompt was closed.
